name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3433: the second eye said classifying the census population by FILENAME is the wrong axis, and it is right in principle. I measured before replacing it: 705 local modules, 110 reachable from production roots, 199 kept by the filename rule, NONE reachable-but-excluded, and ZERO of 33 census targets would change their answer. The graph rule changes nothing today and adds sensitivity to which roots you pick - conftest lands inside it purely because run_gates imports it. So the rule stays and the unexamined assumption becomes a pinned invariant that fails the moment a production-reachable module is named like a test. HEART: this adds no new surface - it pins an invariant under lane_census, whose lanes are already watched by the census rows; the live reading it protects (wait is FOREIGN, zero UNKNOWN targets) is asserted in the gate itself
